no_adcom_quote.quote: This product was not taken to an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because the Office of Hematology and Oncology Products and the Division of Hematology Products have approved other TKIs for the treatment of CML.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for ponatinib (ICLUSIG, NDA203469). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Office Director memo all state the application was not taken to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because other TKIs had already been approved for CML on similar single-arm response-rate designs and comparable applications had not gone to AC. Instead, the review team obtained Special Government Employee input from two clinical experts (Drs. Sekeres and Wilson) and a patient representative, so there was no AC vote and no AC-driven changes to the approval.
